rows.note: This is the all-purpose construction for food cooked by frying, whether pan-fried or fried in oil.

example.english: These fried chicken wings are really crispy.
example.traditional: 呢啲煎炸嘅雞翼好香脆。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 zin1 zaa3 ge3 gai1 jik6 hou2 hoeng1 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this when the food was cooked by being submerged in hot oil, as with deep-fried chicken.

example.english: You should eat the fried chicken leg while it’s hot.
example.jyutping: zaa3 ge3 gai1 bei2 jiu3 can3 jit6 sik6

rows.note: Use this for someone who is completely exhausted after exertion or stress.

example.english: I was completely fried after finishing this job.
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 ni1 daan1 je5 ngo5 gui6 tau3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for being mentally hazy or stoned from drugs, rather than merely tired.

example.english: After taking that pill, they were completely fried.
example.traditional: 食完嗰粒丸之後，佢成個人茫咗。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 go2 lap1 jyun2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 seng4 go3 jan4 mong4 zo2
